hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -f .claude-plugin/marketplace.json ]; then echo "[marketplace-repo] This is the skills marketplace, not an integration: no version is declared in plugin.json or marketplace.json (Claude Code resolves it from the commit SHA), so nothing is ever bumped. templates/ is what ships to scaffolded repos — skill_audit.py and its tests belong there; skill_meta_audit.py is repo-local and must not be shipped. Anything naming a workflow or file that only exists here stays out of plugins/."; fi'

bash -c 'echo "[read-dont-search] A search LOCATES; it does not VERIFY. It cannot tell you a thing is correct, and no matches is not evidence that it is fixed — that mistake shipped a defect as resolved in this repo. Use this only to find candidate files, then READ each one before concluding anything. If you are judging content, open the file instead."'

python3 -c "import json,sys,re; d=json.load(sys.stdin); c=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''); print('[read-dont-search] A search LOCATES; it does not VERIFY. It cannot tell you a thing is correct, and no matches is not evidence that it is fixed — that mistake shipped a defect as resolved in this repo. Use this only to find candidate files, then READ each one before concluding anything. If you are judging content, open the file instead.') if re.search(r'\\b(grep|rg|ag|ack)\\b', c) else None"
